about: The Florida Maritime Museum describes Christmas in Cortez as a free, family-friendly holiday festival with a meet and greet with Santa, bounce houses, games, crafts and face painting.
Cortez is a fishing village in Manatee County, and the festival sits on the museum's grounds. The Cortez Village Historical Society helps by hosting the Santa visits at the Cortez Cultural Center.
The museum lists Music on the Porch for the same day. On December 12 that jam session runs from 2 to 4 PM and moves to the Schoolhouse front porch because of the festival.
The museum says the event is aimed at families with young children, though visitors of any age are welcome, and no reservations are needed.
faq: Is Christmas in Cortez free?
Yes. The museum says admission, parking and all activities are free of charge. Food truck meals are sold for a fee.
When is Christmas in Cortez 2026?
It runs Saturday, December 12, 2026 from noon to 3 PM.
Where do I meet Santa?
Free visits with Santa take place inside the Cortez Cultural Center.
Is the museum open during the event?
No. The museum says it will not be open because of a structural rehabilitation of its historic building.
Where do I park?
The museum lists overflow parking at the F.I.S.H. Preserve on Cortez Road, at 4411 116th St W in Bradenton.
Do I need to register?
No reservations are required.

kids: Face painting and a free book for the first 300 children
site: The Bay Park lawn for the Toy Story 5 movie under the stars
Sarasota Performing Arts Foundation tent for crafts and free books
about: The Bay Sarasota calls this its fifth annual community celebration and presents it with support from the Community Foundation of Sarasota County.
Mr. Stevey is a Tampa-based teaching artist and children's book author. Santa's Frosty Follies is a long-running holiday production presented in the Sarasota area by the Signature School of the Arts.
The Bay asks guests to bring gently used children's books to give a new home in the Lending Libraries throughout the park. Well-behaved pets on a leash up to 6 feet are welcome outdoors.
Free parking is offered first come, first served in front of the Van Wezel, at the Municipal Auditorium and Blue Pagoda, and along the north side of Boulevard of the Arts.
faq: Is Holidays at The Bay free?
Yes. The Bay lists the celebration as free, including the photo with Santa. The event page links to an Eventbrite registration.
What time does it start?
The event runs December 12 from 4:00 to 7:45 PM, with Santa and crafts from 4 to 6 PM.
What movie is shown?
The Bay lists a family showing of Toy Story 5, rated PG, from 6 to 7:45 PM.
Where do I park?
Free first come parking is in front of the Van Wezel at 777 N. Tamiami Trail, at the Municipal Auditorium and Blue Pagoda at 655 N. Tamiami Trail, and along the north side of Boulevard of the Arts.
What happens if it rains?
The Bay says the event is cancelled in inclement weather and posts updates up to one hour before the start.
Can I bring a dog?
Well-behaved, non-aggressive pets are welcome on a leash up to 6 feet. Indoor events allow only service dogs.
